user.title: Set up Ambience
user.description: This will create the Ambience integration entry.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

data_description.show_sidebar_panel: When off, Ambience is removed from the sidebar. You can still add the Ambience card to any dashboard.
data_description.create_switches: When on, Ambience creates a switch entity (and device) for each enabled area, floor, and the house — used to pause that scope. When off, no switches are created. Disabling a scope deletes its switch.
data_description.expose_assist: Allow Home Assistant's built-in Assist voice agent to control the Ambience switches.
data_description.expose_google: Expose the Ambience switches to Google Assistant (requires Home Assistant Cloud or a manual Google Assistant setup).
data_description.expose_alexa: Expose the Ambience switches to Alexa (requires Home Assistant Cloud or a manual Alexa setup).

missing_entity.title: Ambience: a scene references a missing entity
missing_entity.description: The entity `{entity_id}` is referenced by scene(s) {scenes} but does not exist in Home Assistant. A condition referencing it will never match; an action targeting it will fail silently. Fix the entity id in the Ambience editor or remove the reference. This message clears automatically once the entity exists.

action_overlap.title: Ambience: an entity is controlled by multiple groups
action_overlap.description: `{entity_id}` is controlled by more than one category/scope group ({groups}). Each group is an independent control loop with its own state, so they can fight over this entity and produce stale or no-op applies. Consider moving it into a single group. This message clears automatically once the overlap is resolved.
